description: This file implements the main React component for the 'Roadmap' journey page in a Next.js project. It includes UI for a mind map visualization of roles and skills, a pathway timeline for milestones, and various helper functions for managing state, rendering nodes, edges, and user interactions.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Parses a JSON string from localStorage into a string array, safely handling errors and invalid data.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string with a specified prefix.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within a specified [a, b] range.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date as a string in yyyy-mm-dd format.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a default RolePlan object with mock data for a given roleId.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads the roadmap’s active role ID and plans from localStorage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap's active role ID and plans to localStorage.

methods.name: getMindMapModel
methods.description: Generates the nodes and edges for the mind map visualization based on role data and layout parameters.

methods.name: nodeSize
methods.description: Determines the display size (diameter) for a node element.

methods.name: edgeStyle
methods.description: Returns styling parameters for an edge (line) based on its weight.

methods.name: MindMapNodeView
methods.description: Renders an individual node in the mind map, including interactive hover and click behavior.

methods.name: MindMapSideCard
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a hovered or selected node in a side panel.

methods.name: MindMapTooltip
methods.description: Shows a tooltip with node info that follows the cursor when hovering.

methods.name: MindMapCanvas
methods.description: Main component rendering the interactive mind map visual, including nodes, edges, tooltips, and user interactions.
